\section*{Quiz 3 --- Version A}

\textbf{True/False}
\begin{enumerate}
  \item A square is a rhombus.
  \item Every rectangle is a square.
\end{enumerate}

\textbf{Multiple choice}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
  \item What is the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon?
  \begin{enumerate}[label=(\Alph*)]
    \item $360^\circ$
    \item $540^\circ$
    \item $720^\circ$
  \end{enumerate}

  \item How many diagonals does a hexagon have?
  \begin{enumerate}[label=(\Alph*)]
    \item 6
    \item 9
    \item 12
  \end{enumerate}

  \item Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
  \begin{enumerate}[label=(\Alph*)]
    \item trapezoid
    \item kite
    \item parallelogram
  \end{enumerate}
  \begin{itemize}
    \item (an itemize inside a question stays with it)
  \end{itemize}
\end{enumerate}
